metadata.description: Claude Code mods: pixel-art pomodoro, subagent progress bars, a command guard and a cost-saving model router

plugins.name: pomodoro
plugins.description: Pixel-art pomodoro timer in a side pane: /focus [minutes]

plugins.name: agent-progress
plugins.description: Live progress bars for running subagents above the prompt

plugins.name: cmd-guard
plugins.description: Asks before running destructive shell commands: recursive deletes, force pushes, dropping tables

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Runs Explore subagents on haiku and general-purpose ones on sonnet unless a model was asked for
